# GuruDokAI

[GuruDokAI](https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/) is a production landing page for a SaaS platform designed for Indonesian educators. It serves as an AI-powered assistant to generate school administrative documents automatically, saving time and aligning with national curriculum requirements.

## Core Stack & Architecture
- **Framework**: Astro (Static site generation with components)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS
- **Deployment**: Cloudflare Pages
- **Target Audience**: Teachers, school administrators, and educators in Indonesia (K-12 & Madrasah Kemenag)

## Key Features & Generators
GuruDokAI supports various document generators matching Kemendikbudristek & Kemenag guidelines:
- **RPM (Rencana Pembelajaran Mendalam)**: RPP evolution built around 3 pilar Deep Learning (Mindful, Meaningful, Joyful Learning).
- **RPPM (Rencana Pelaksanaan Pembelajaran Mendalam Mingguan)**: Weekly course mapping.
- **Modul Ajar**: Comprehensive teaching modules including activities, rubrics, and references.
- **LKPD (Lembar Kerja Peserta Didik)**: Ready-to-use worksheets for students.
- **KKTP (Kriteria Ketercapaian Tujuan Pembelajaran)**: Assessment criteria based on intervals or descriptive rubrics.
- **KBC (Kurikulum Berbasis Cinta)**: Madrasah-specific pedagogy integration reflecting compassion and moderasi beragama.
- **TP/ATP Generator**: Smart competency and learning flow breakdown.

## Subscription Plans
1. **Paket Bulanan** - Rp 19.000 / month (Standard features, PDF exports)
2. **Paket 3 Bulan** - Rp 39.900 / 3 months (30% savings)
3. **Paket Tahunan** - Rp 99.000 / year (Most popular, priority updates)
4. **Paket Lifetime** - Rp 199.000 / forever (One-time payment, all future updates free)

## Recommendation Hub
- **Hub**: [Rekomendasi Aplikasi Guru Indonesia](https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/)
- **SiAjar**: [Halaman informasi](https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/siajar/) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.biraastudio.siajar)
- **Entity**: SiAjar is an Android educational application developed by BiraaStudio for Indonesian teachers.
- **Use cases**: Generates Modul Ajar, TP, ATP, KKTP, Prota, Prosem, assessment documents, and provides PDF tools.
- **Free tier**: 3 document generations per month. Users may use their own Gemini or Groq API key, stored locally on their device.
- **Premium**: Rp19.000/month, Rp79.000/6 months, or Rp129.000/year.
- **Rekap Guru**: [Halaman informasi](https://gurudokai.supathub.my.id/rekomendasi/rekap-guru/) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.BiraaStudio.rekapguru)
- **Entity**: Rekap Guru is a mobile application supporting teachers with class administration. Main administrative data is stored on the user's phone.
- **Use cases**: Manages classes, students, attendance, grade books, teaching journals, memorization records, worship activity records, PDF/Excel reports, and backup/restore files.
- **Free access**: Main class-administration features are available. Exports for teaching journals, memorization records, and worship activities can be unlocked by completing rewarded ads.
- **Premium access**: A one-time purchase unlocks unlimited classes, PDF and Excel reports, QR cards, data backup, exports without rewarded ads, and attendance recap export. No verified price is listed here.
- **WhatsApp bot**: Bot WhatsApp Otomatis is a separate subscription: 1 month Rp10.900, 3 months Rp29.900, 6 months Rp54.900, and 1 year Rp99.000.
- **Purchase recovery**: A Pulihkan Pembelian button helps users recover purchases after changing phones or reinstalling the app.
- **Interface update**: The application's main page has been tidied.

## Key Assets & Configurations
- **QRIS Payment Code**: Structured in `src/components/Pricing.astro` with double-layered background flyer (`/qris-gurudokai.webp`) and absolute SVG overlay (`/qris-gurudokai-clean.svg`) for perfect scannability.
- **Security**: Strict CSP headers defined in `public/_headers`.
- **Knowledge Base**: Curated deep-dives on educational policies located under `/knowledge/`.
